profile_text.body:
The website at alantra.com describes Alantra as an international financial services firm with over 500 professionals across EMEA, the Americas, and Asia. It says the firm provides investment banking and alternative asset management services to corporations, family-owned companies, and institutional investors, and describes a listed partnership model in which teams work within corporate governance structures while operating with autonomy and being personally invested in the firm.

The company record lists ALLIENT INC as a for-profit public company headquartered in Williamsville, New York, trading under the ticker ALNT, with SEC CIK 0000046129. No products are tracked for it and no MCP servers are listed. The site text does not describe any AI products or AI work, so nothing in the material places the company in the AI market.

No lawsuits are listed for the company. Its recorded litigation exposure is in New York, with a count of 458.
